errors.evidence: The list of x-axis tick marks is incomplete. It omits the labels for 3e8, 4e8, 6e8, 7e8, and 8e8, which are all present in the figure.
The markers for the 'SepLLM (n=64)' line are described as squares, but they are clearly plus signs (+) in the figure.

The description states that the 'SepLLM (n=128)' line reaches ~99.8% at 5e7 TFLOPs, but the plot shows the value at this point is approximately 99.0%. The line reaches ~99.8% later, around 2e8 TFLOPs.
The description claims the 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' line reaches ~100% at 5e7 TFLOPs. The plot shows the value at this point is approximately 99.2%; it does not reach ~100% until 2e8 TFLOPs.
The description states the value for 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' at 5e7 TFLOPs is ~97.8%, but the data point is visibly lower, at approximately 97.2%.

The description incorrectly identifies the peak of the 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' line as occurring at 5e8 TFLOPs. The actual peak is at 4e8 TFLOPs. At 5e8 TFLOPs, the value has already decreased to approximately 98.4%.
